# @aponiajs/mvc

> Inertia component and prop protocol for React and Vue.

## Exports

- `Inertia(component, options?)`: route decorator that answers the Inertia protocol
- `createInertiaResponse(component, props, request, options?)`
- `inertia(component, props, context, options?)`
- `defaultInertiaRootView`
- Types: `InertiaPage`, `InertiaOptions`
